spans.s:
अमुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A certain person or thing, any thing or person
referred to without a name.
 E. अमु for अदस् this, and कन् added.

अमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
 1. Not loosed, not let go.
 2. Not liberated from
birth and death.
 n. (-क्तं) A weapon that is always grasped to be
used, as a knife, &c. See मुक्तामुक्त, यन्त्रामुक्त, &c.
 E. अ neg. and मुक्त
released.

आमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
 1. Loosed, let go.
 2. Discharged, cast, shot.
 3.
Put on as clothes or armour.
 4. Dressed, accoutred.
 E. आङ् before
मुच to release, unbind, &c. क्त aff.

अमुक्तहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Sparing, frugal, prudent.
 E. अमुक्त not loosed,
हस्त the hand.

अमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Confinement, want of freedom or liberty.
 E. अ neg. मुक्ति
liberation.

आमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः)
 1. Liberation, being let loose.
 2. Final liberation. ind.
(-क्ति) To be end of existence.
 E. आङ् and मुक्ति liberation.

अमुख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Inferior, ordinary.
 E. अ neg. मुख्य principal.

अमुतस् ind. Hence, from this.
 E. अमु for अदस् and तसिल् aff.

अमुत्र ind. In the next life.
 E. अमु from अदस् this or that, and त्रल् aff.

अमुत्रत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Belonging to a future state, being of the next
world.
 E. अमुत्र and त्य aff.

अमुष्यपुत्र mf. (-त्रः-त्री)
 1. Of a good family, of known origin.
 2. The son
or daughter of such a one.
 E. अमुष्य the irr. gen. of अदस् this, and पुत्र
a son, &c.

अमुष्यायण mf. (-णः-णा)
 1. Of respectable birth, of known origin.
 2. The
offspring of such a one, of a certain person, &c.
 E. अमुष्य as in the
last, and फक् affix, also आमुष्यायण.

आमुष्यायण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Of an illustrious family, well born, well
descended.
 E. अमुष्य the genitive of अदस् this, and फक् aff.

अमूदृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Of such form or kind.
 E. अमू for अदस् this, and क्विप्
affix; also अमूदृश and अमूदृक्ष
अमूदृश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Of such a form or kind. E. See the last.
अमूदृक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Such, like of such form or kind. E. See अमूदृश.

अमूर्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Formless, shapeless, unembodied.
 E. अ neg. मूर्त्ति
form; the final changed.

अमूर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Shapelessness, absence of shape or form.
 E. अ. neg. मूर्त्ति
form.

अमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Having no root. Also अमूलक.
 f. (-ला) A plant. See
अग्निशिखा.
 E. अ neg. and मूल a root.

आमूल adv.
 n. (-स्तं) To the root, by the root, entirely, radically.
 E. आङ्
particle, and मूल root.

अमूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) Invaluable, not to be purchased.
 E. अ neg. मूल्य
price.

आमुख n. (-खं)
 1. Prelude, prologue.
 2. Commencement. ind. To the
face.
 E. आङ् before मुख face or beginning.
आमुप m. (-पः) A thorny kind of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa, Rox.)
